entries.zh: 查验搜寻；逐件检视以寻找
entries.en: to search by examining; to inspect in looking for something
entries.notes: 汉字「験/驗」形近存疑、M 栏一音标污损（T99），西语尾句 vna barjleta alladron 难辨；依「搜験＝Buscar examinando」定为查验搜寻。

entries.zh: 张望寻找；边看边搜
entries.en: to search by looking about; to look around for something
entries.notes: 第二字「昏/省」形近存疑；据 M 栏存录之 mirado 与西语词头定为张望寻找。

entries.zh: 翻找；翻动搜寻（拨弄翻检而寻）
entries.en: to search by rummaging; to turn things over in looking for

entries.zh: 为施行而寻求；寻找以便执行（寻机办理）
entries.en: to seek in order to execute or carry out (a thing or command)
entries.notes: 西语缩写「p」按惯例推展为 para，属推断；汉字「搜估」与此义项对应不甚直接，释义以西语词头为主。

entries.zh: 翻箱寻找；搜检箱箧（翻箱倒柜）
entries.en: to rummage through the box or chest

entries.zh: 讨取；索要；乞讨（向人讨一物）
entries.en: to ask for something; to beg; to solicit

entries.zh: 雇工夫；雇工（出钱请人做工）
entries.en: to hire laborers; to seek work or arrange for workmen

entries.zh: 讨罚；究办治罪（如西人所谓惩戒无赖）
entries.en: to demand or seek punishment (as we say, of a rogue); to call to account

entries.zh: 讨气受；自惹恼怒（招人嗔怪责骂）
entries.en: to court anger; to invite scolding or annoyance

entries.zh: 求乞；恳求；祈求
entries.en: to seek by entreating; to beg or pray for

entries.zh: 谋生；求财（寻生计、觅活路）
entries.en: to seek one's living; to earn a livelihood; to look for one's fortune

entries.zh: 筹措；置办（求取自己没有的东西）
entries.en: to procure what one lacks; to obtain what one does not have

entries.zh: 措致；设法求得；筹办致得
entries.en: to manage to obtain; to procure or attain

entries.zh: 捞翻；翻捡（在案头翻找文件）
entries.en: to rummage through; to fish out (papers on the desk)
entries.notes: 西语「vta」为缩写，依上下文推展（疑为 vuelta「翻动」），属推断；escriptor 与后条 escriptorio 同指书案。

entries.zh: 捞寻；在案头翻捡寻找
entries.en: to rummage about (on a desk); to hunt through
entries.notes: 西语「vt」为缩写，依推展（疑为 vuelta），属推断。

entries.zh: 捉寻；四下追捕寻找（循迹缉寻）
entries.en: to hunt for; to go in pursuit of
entries.notes: M 栏第二音标污损（T99）；西语词头仅作 Buscar，依汉字「捉尋」定为捕捉寻找。

entries.zh: 攀托势力；谋求人情庇护（求人援引）
entries.en: to seek favor; to court patronage or influence
entries.notes: 首字「扐」罕见难定、M 栏一处音标污损（T99）；依西语 buscar favor 定为谋求人情势力。

entries.zh: 连尾去寻；接踵成串追寻（随众接连寻找）
entries.en: to search in a line or crowd, following on; to trail along in search of something
entries.notes: 缩写「alg.」推展为 algo；西语 trapel 疑为 en tropel（成群）之讹，与「連尾」义近。

entries.zh: 寻钱；找钱（觅取钱财）
entries.en: to look for money; to seek cash
entries.notes: 汉字首字形近存疑（比/此），「比接」与寻钱之对应不明，释义以西语词头为主。

entries.zh: 跟寻；跟踪追寻（尾随某人寻找）
entries.en: to follow in pursuit of someone; to track down

entries.zh: 查究来历；探问原委（多方打听以求根源）
entries.en: to inquire into the origin of something; to investigate by asking about
entries.notes: 首字形近存疑（討/計）；「討論」取古义「探究推寻」，非现代辩论义。

entries.zh: 追寻；寻找遗失之物；追讨失物
entries.en: to search for what is lost; to track down lost things
